guide-wallet1: How-to Guide: Connecting MetaMask to Binance Smart Chain
guide-wallet3:
Start by downloading MetaMask for Chrome, Brave, iOS, and Android.
- Next, create a wallet
- Write down the backup seed phrase somewhere secure (preferably not on an Internet-connected device)
- Without this phrase, your funds can’t be recovered if your device is damaged or lost
- Finally, confirm your seed phrase by following the on-screen instructions
- And voila! Your wallet is ready to send, store, and receive tokens.
guide-wallet5:
- You might notice that we’re still at the Ethereum main network.This won’t work with Binance Smart Chain DApps. At worst, you could lose funds by sending them to addresses you can’t actually use.
- You can quickly configure binance smart chain by visiting Binance Smart Chain Explorer(bscscan.com),After accessing the homepage ofBinance Smart Chain Explorer(bscscan.com), you will see a button with MetaMask icon and “Add BSC Network” on the bottom right of the page.
- click this button, MetaMask extension will pop up, and click Approve to give permission.Now you have completed the configuration,and you are ready to use your wallet on Binance Smart Chain.
guide-wallet7:
- If you are temporarily unable to access Binance Smart Chain Explorer (bscscan.com), you can also manually configure the wallet.
- Let’s change that. We need to access Settings to point the wallet towards Binance Smart Chain nodes.
- On the Settings page, click the Networks.
- Click Add Network in the top-right corner to manually add Binance Smart Chain Mainnet.
- Network Name: Binance Smart Chain
- New RPC URL: https://bsc-dataseed.binance.org/
- ChainID: 56
- Symbol: BNB
- Block Explorer URL: https://bscscan.com
- Once you Save the Network and return to the main view, you’ll notice two things: the network has automatically been set to the one you just entered, and the units are no longer denominated in ETH, but in BNB.

home-title: Welcome to the PlotBridge beta version

home-news.msg: The PlotBridge website has been upgraded with a fresh interface and light/dark themes; Bridge / Swap / Market / Stake all remain, now with clearer layouts. This upgrade only touches the frontend — contract addresses and on-chain data are unchanged, and no action is needed.

Deposits for HDDcoin / Chives / Flax are now closed, as their node software is long unmaintained and their networks are unstable (WXCH bridging is not affected). Holders can bind a withdrawal address and burn the tokens on the Bridge page to request the native coins. The team processes requests manually, usually within 7 working days, provided the underlying chain still runs.
Happy New Year! We just released the annual revamp of our website and have added support for two new coins: HDDcoin and Flax, looking forward to your participation.
We have made a simple tool for XCC Deposit Activity participants to browse their score and ranking, at: https://xcc-mints.plotbridge.io
We have provided a preliminary support for mobile wallet (with WalletConnect).
Deposit XCC into Plotbridge and win the PBP rewards. Details please see  https://www.plotbridge.io/activities/crosspb/

The burning reward starts. User can receive PBP reward when burning WXCH, WXCC and NFT token PBT. The reward amount is related to reward pool balance and burning token amount.

intruction1:
PlotBridge is a gateway/bridge between various plot-based blockchain networks (PoST networks like Chia, Chives, etc.) and mature smart blockchain networks (Binance Smart Chain, etc.). It can be used to wrap native coins like Chia(XCH), Chives(XCC) into corresponding tokens like WXCH, WXCC and, of course, unwrap tokens back into the corresponding native coins.
